mapper.select: SELECT ah.id, ah.user_id, ah.workspace_id, ah.company_name, ah.position_title, ah.application_status, ah.result_stage, ah.result_label, ah.raw_result, ah.deadline_label, ah.period_key, ah.period_year, ah.period_half, ah.source_url, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.company_type, ''), NULLIF(ah.company_type, ''), '미확인') AS company_type, NULLIF(cp.industry, '') AS company_industry, CASE WHEN cp.id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(cp.source_priority, '') != 'RULE_BASED_INTERNAL' THEN 'MASTER' WHEN cp.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'RULE' WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(c.domain, ''), 'unknown') != 'unknown' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(c.company_type, ''), '미확인') != '미확인' THEN 'RULE' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS company_data_source FROM ( SELECT ah.id, ah.user_id, ah.workspace_id, ah.company_name, ah.position_title, ah.application_status, ah.result_stage, ah.result_label, ah.raw_result, ah.deadline_label, ah.deadline_date, ah.period_key, ah.period_year, ah.period_half, ah.source_url, ah.company_type FROM application_history ah UNION ALL SELECT (1000000000 + bj.id) AS id, bj.user_id, w.id AS workspace_id, c.name AS company_name, j.title AS position_title, CASE WHEN bj.application_status = 'READY' AND COALESCE( j.deadline_at, CASE WHEN j.deadline_label REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}[.-][0-9]{1,2}[.-][0-9]{1,2}' THEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(j.deadline_label, '.', '-'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END ) < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'NOT_APPLIED' ELSE bj.application_status END AS application_status, CASE WHEN bj.application_status IN ('READY', 'NOT_APPLIED') THEN 'NOT_APPLIED' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END AS result_stage, CASE WHEN bj.application_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN '지원완료' WHEN bj.application_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN '진행 중' WHEN bj.application_status = 'READY' AND COALESCE( j.deadline_at, CASE WHEN j.deadline_label REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}[.-][0-9]{1,2}[.-][0-9]{1,2}' THEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(j.deadline_label, '.', '-'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END ) < CURRENT_DATE THEN '미지원' WHEN bj.application_status = 'READY' THEN '지원 전' ELSE '미지원' END AS result_label, CASE WHEN bj.application_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN '지원완료' WHEN bj.application_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN '진행 중' WHEN bj.application_status = 'READY' AND COALESCE( j.deadline_at, CASE WHEN j.deadline_label REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}[.-][0-9]{1,2}[.-][0-9]{1,2}' THEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(j.deadline_label, '.', '-'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END ) < CURRENT_DATE THEN '마감 경과' WHEN bj.application_status = 'READY' THEN '지원 전' ELSE '미지원' END AS raw_result, j.deadline_label, COALESCE( j.deadline_at, CASE WHEN j.deadline_label REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}[.-][0-9]{1,2}[.-][0-9]{1,2}' THEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(j.deadline_label, '.', '-'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END ) AS deadline_date, CONCAT(YEAR(COALESCE( j.deadline_at, CASE WHEN j.deadline_label REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}[.-][0-9]{1,2}[.-][0-9]{1,2}' THEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(j.deadline_label, '.', '-'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END, CURRENT_DATE )), '-', CASE WHEN MONTH(COALESCE( j.deadline_at, CASE WHEN j.deadline_label REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}[.-][0-9]{1,2}[.-][0-9]{1,2}' THEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(j.deadline_label, '.', '-'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END, CURRENT_DATE )) <= 6 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END) AS period_key, YEAR(COALESCE( j.deadline_at, CASE WHEN j.deadline_label REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}[.-][0-9]{1,2}[.-][0-9]{1,2}' THEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(j.deadline_label, '.', '-'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END, CURRENT_DATE )) AS period_year, CASE WHEN MONTH(COALESCE( j.deadline_at, CASE WHEN j.deadline_label REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}[.-][0-9]{1,2}[.-][0-9]{1,2}' THEN STR_TO_DATE(REPLACE(j.deadline_label, '.', '-'), '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END, CURRENT_DATE )) <= 6 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS period_half, j.url AS source_url, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.company_type, ''), '기타기업') AS company_type FROM basket_jobs bj JOIN jobs j ON j.id = bj.job_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id JOIN workspaces w ON w.basket_job_id = bj.id WHERE bj.deleted_at IS NULL AND bj.saved_source != 'HISTORY_IMPORT' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_history existing WHERE existing.workspace_id = w.id ) AND bj.application_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'NOT_APPLIED', 'READY') ) ah LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = ah.workspace_id LEFT JOIN basket_jobs bj ON bj.id = w.basket_job_id LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id = bj.job_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id LEFT JOIN company_profiles cp ON cp.company_id = c.id WHERE ah.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT ( bj.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(bj.saved_source, '') != 'HISTORY_IMPORT' AND ah.application_status = 'READY' ) ORDER BY ah.period_year DESC, ah.period_half DESC, ah.deadline_date IS NULL, ah.deadline_date ASC, ah.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE application_history SET application_status = #{applicationStatus}, result_stage = #{resultStage}, result_label = #{resultLabel}, raw_result = #{resultLabel}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{historyApplicationId} AND user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE application_history SET application_status = #{applicationStatus}, result_stage = #{resultStage}, result_label = #{resultLabel}, raw_result = #{resultLabel}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
